title: Milnor fibrations on rho-tubes and rho-spheres for real analytic map germs
summary: For a real analytic map germ $G:(\mathbb{R}^m,0)\to(\mathbb{R}^p,0)$, we study Milnor fibrations obtained by replacing the squared Euclidean distance with an analytic control function $ρ$ defining the origin. We formulate the corresponding Milnor set and condition (b), derive criteria for tube and sphere fibrations, and examine their dependence on $ρ$. The family $G_ρ=(xz,\,yzρ)$ provides explicit changes of regularity under elliptic controls.
